topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I found out something about Mrs. Thompson, our neighbor. It seems she's been quietly living a far more affluent life than anyone could have guessed. I stumbled upon this information accidentally, through an old, forgotten folder left in the park near her house. My first thought was to return it, but curiosity got the better of me. As I looked through the documents, I saw the extent of her wealth, details of investments and properties. It feels wrong to know this, like I’ve intruded on a secret she never meant for anyone to find. I should have just taken it back without looking, but now it seems too late for that. I’ll have to find a way to return it, soon, without letting on that I read anything.
